description: This file implements the Reaction store for Mattermost, handling database operations related to reactions on posts, including saving, deleting, querying, and batch operations.

classes.name: SqlReactionStore
classes.description: Struct implementing reaction-related database operations for Mattermost.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a reaction to the database, creating or updating as necessary.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a reaction from the database.

methods.name: GetForPost
methods.description: Retrieves all reactions for a specific post that are not deleted.

methods.name: ExistsOnPost
methods.description: Checks if a specific reaction exists on a post.

methods.name: GetForPostSince
methods.description: Retrieves reactions for a post updated after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: GetUniqueCountForPost
methods.description: Counts distinct emoji reactions on a post.

methods.name: GetSingle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reaction based on user, post, remote ID, and emoji.

methods.name: DeleteAllWithEmojiName
methods.description: Deletes all reactions with a specific emoji name.

methods.name: permanentDeleteReactions
methods.description: Permanently deletes reactions for a user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all reactions by a user.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedRowsByIds
methods.description: Deletes orphaned reaction rows based on retention IDs.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteBatch
methods.description: Deletes a batch of reactions created before a certain time.

methods.name: saveReactionAndUpdatePost
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reaction and updates the related post.

methods.name: deleteReactionAndUpdatePost
methods.description: Deletes a reaction and updates the related post.

methods.name: updatePostForReactionsOnDelete
methods.description: Updates post to reflect deletion of reactions.

methods.name: updatePostForReactionsOnInsert
methods.description: Updates post to reflect insertion of reactions.
